title: Edit tax rate is hidden once invoiced or without permission
custom_preconds:
1. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  2. An invoiced or paid part sale. Seed it: create a part sale as above, receive its parts so it reaches Complete, then click Create Invoice.
  3. Also a test user WITHOUT Part sales -> Create & Edit (set under Settings -> Staff / Roles).
custom_steps:
1. On the invoiced or paid sale, open the Financial Info card and look for Edit tax rate.
  2. Sign in as the user without the permission, open a part sale, and look for the Edit tax rate control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On an invoiced or paid sale the Financial Info card is read-only and the Edit tax rate control is not shown.
  • A user without Part sales -> Create & Edit does not see the Edit tax rate control at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10264 (Change the tax on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 3; design canvas boards S3_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “Once the part sale is invoiced or paid, the card is read-only and the action is not offered”
  • S3-N2: “A user without the permission above does not see the action”

Last checked against build v26.39.2-210868d on 10/1/2026.
